input.title: 2017 Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 14 (180)
input.descriptionHtml:
Immaculate pre-owned 2017 Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 14 in Camo with custom shark-mouth graphics. MirageDrive 180 powered and fully rigged with H-Bar, Anchor Trolley, Bass Pro Xtreme Drift Anchor, Lowran

2017 Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 14 Immaculate, Fully Rigged, Camo

This is the kayak serious anglers build their setup around and this one already has the build done for you. The 2017 Mirage Pro Angler 14 is Hobie's flagship fishing platform: 13'8" of stable, standable, gear-hauling hull powered by the MirageDrive 180 pedal system with reverse, so you can hold position over a school or back off a snag without ever putting down a rod. The Vantage ST elevated seat keeps you comfortable for full-day sessions, six horizontal rod lockers swallow your tackle box, and the H-Rail system around the cockpit gives you near-infinite mounting real estate.

This particular unit is in immaculate condition and finished in Hobie's sought-after Camo hull perfect for blending into shoreline structure and a rare find on the used market. The previous owner added custom shark-mouth graphics to both bows in classic Flying Tigers style, making this PA14 unmistakable on the water. Beyond the looks, it comes loaded with the accessories most PA14 buyers add piece-by-piece over their first season. You're not buying a used kayak that needs another $1,000 in upgrades you're buying one that's already dialed in and ready to launch.

Included Accessories

  • Hobie H-Bar Hobie's purpose-built standing assist bar designed for the PA series. Gives you a solid handhold for standing up to sight-fish or fight a strong fish, plus additional rail space for mounting gear.
  • Anchor Trolley Pulley system running bow-to-stern along the hull, letting you reposition your anchor point on the fly without re-anchoring. Critical for holding the right angle to wind, current, and structure.
  • Bass Pro Shops Xtreme Drift Anchor Drift chute that slows and stabilizes your drift in wind or current. Perfect for vertical jigging, controlled drift presentations, and keeping a clean line on a slow troll. Still in original packaging.
  • Lowrance HOOK 5 with SplitShot Transducer 5" color fishfinder/chartplotter combo with autotuning sonar, wide-angle CHIRP for broader bottom coverage, and DownScan imaging for picture-like views of structure and fish beneath the kayak.
  • Hobie Heavy Duty Kayak Cart Hobie's purpose-built transport cart with foam-filled (no-flat) wheels. Plugs into the kayak's scupper holes and rolls the fully rigged 145+ lb PA14 from your vehicle to the water single-handedly. An essential accessory typically sold separately.
  • Hobie Paddle Two-piece backup paddle included as standard equipment.
  • Custom Shark-Mouth Graphics One-of-a-kind angler-customized Flying Tigers-style shark mouth on both bows.
 

Specifications

Model Year 2017
Condition Immaculate (Pre-Owned)
Hull Color Camo
Length 13' 8" / 4.17 m
Width 38" / 0.97 m
Height 20" / 0.51 m
Capacity 600 lbs / 272 kg
Vantage Seat Capacity 350 lbs / 159 kg
Fitted Hull Weight 120.5 lbs / 55 kg
Fully Rigged Weight 145.5 lbs / 66 kg
Drive MirageDrive 180 (forward & reverse)
Hull Construction Rotomolded Polyethylene
Price $3,125

See it in person. This PA14 is at our showroom in Ottawa, IL. Pre-owned PA14s in Camo with this much rigging already done don't sit long stop in or call to lock it down.
